title: Capstone 2 ADM Completion Gate, Sequential Chapter Revision Blocking & Interactive Drag-and-Drop Defense Calendar
objectives: Strictly gate Capstone 2 completion behind full Action Done Matrix (ADM v1) approval (admStatus === 'approved')
Normalize capstonePhase to 2 if ADM is unapproved, preventing premature progression to Phase 3 in UI and backend
Block subsequent chapter submissions on both client and backend when previous chapter has revisions required or is unapproved
Refactor DefenseSchedulingPage into an interactive weekly calendar with 1-hour time slots and an Awaiting Scheduling draggable tray
Default defense round to '1st Round (Standard Defense)' for unscheduled hearings and standardize 1-hour presets
Verify via fast-path targeted tests, full quality gate battery, and Playwright visual audits across Light/Dark and Desktop/Mobile

deliverables.summary: Updated uploadChapter to query latest chapter version via .sort({ version: -1 }) and strictly assert approval before allowing next chapter.
Enforced isADMApproved in advancePhase and added _normalizeProjectADMPhase to getProject/getMyProject to prevent phase jump if ADM is not approved.
Exported isADMApproved helper and updated resolveCurrentStep to hold step at Capstone 2 when ADM is pending.
Updated getPhaseLabel to display Phase 2 when ADM is not approved.
Updated resolveProjectDefaultTab to keep default tab on capstone_2 when ADM is pending.
Added accepted status configuration with CheckCircle2 and mapped accepted to GATE_STATUSES and isApproved.
Added explicit previous chapter unapproved checks, inline warning alerts, and locked select options.
Defaulted round to '1st' (1st Round Standard Defense) for unscheduled hearings, set default slot to 1-hour, and added 1-hour preset buttons.
Implemented calendar-first view with week navigation, 1-hour slots grid, HTML5 drag-and-drop scheduling/rescheduling, and Awaiting Scheduling tray.
Playwright visual feedback audit validating ADM gate, chapter blocking, interactive calendar, and 1st round modal.
